summary: Full resolution of Codex Review Findings R1-R5 for DRIVE-01-F08: (R1) Bounded resource ownership and elimination of off-budget retention by enforcing strict scalar vs resource-producing boundaries in DriveIoExecutor, eliminating chargesPending=false, and mathematically bounding retained obligations <= pending <= cleanupQueueCapacity; (R2) Launcher stale bytecode prevention via mandatory incremental compilation on every start and active 35s readiness polling; (R3) Fail-closed stop script verifying live process identity (PID, java.exe, ExecutablePath, CommandLine with MovieRcmApplication/snapshot, CreationDate delta < 3s); (R4) Strict browser verification in test_live_browser_f08.cjs using timeline slider events only (zero direct currentTime assignment), 3 seek points (60s, 200s, 400s), requestVideoFrameCallback decoded frame presentation (1920x1080), post-seek time advancement, and stable pause (drift=0.000s); (R5) Live end-to-end verification of Qwen3-4B + Phase 23 LoRA on RTX 3050 CUDA, real Google Drive X: streaming (videoplayback.mp4, 29,209,556 B, HTTP 206), WinFsp toFile().canRead() optimization, clean isolated patch against base c2d29c04edd58c4cc0a6e648d316285a9377384f, and complete shutdown/unmount at handoff.

R1_boundedResourceAdmission.finding: executeWithTimeout lacked lifecycle pre-admission, retaining close failures with chargesPending=false and allowing unbounded retained handles exceeding cleanupQueueCapacity.
R1_boundedResourceAdmission.resolution: Enforced strict scalar vs resource boundary: executeMetadata and executeRead delegate to executeScalar (pure scalar lane, strictly forbids AutoCloseable, bounded by maxWorkers, 0 lifecycle permits consumed). Resource-producing executeWithTimeout requires lifecycle pre-admission via acquireReservation(), failing fast if cur.getTotal() >= capacity. Retained cleanups always charge pending obligations (chargesPending=true). Fixed callerPool read worker race in DriveCleanupQueueSaturationTest:377.
R1_boundedResourceAdmission.tests: DriveGenericMetadataReproTest (4/4 PASS), DriveCleanupQueueSaturationTest (3/3 PASS), full backend suite (161/161 PASS)

R2_launcherBytecodeFreshness.finding: scripts/start_backend_dev.ps1 built only if classes/cp.txt were missing, risking execution of stale bytecode on subsequent launches.
R2_launcherBytecodeFreshness.resolution: Updated start_backend_dev.ps1 to invoke incremental compilation unconditionally on every start ('mvnw compile dependency:build-classpath'). Implemented active polling against /api/movies with a 35s finite deadline and clean port collision rejection.

R3_failClosedProcessIdentity.finding: stop_backend_dev.ps1 verified only process name java and StartTime within 2s, leaving PID reuse races and failing to inspect canonical executable and arguments.
R3_failClosedProcessIdentity.resolution: Rewrote stop_backend_dev.ps1 using Get-CimInstance Win32_Process. Inspects and matches PID, process name java.exe, canonical ExecutablePath, CommandLine containing MovieRcmApplication and snapshot profile, and CreationDate delta < 3s, failing closed without signaling if any check fails.

R4_strictBrowserTimelineVerification.finding: test_live_browser_f07.cjs directly assigned video.currentTime, tested only 1 seek point (60s), and lacked requestVideoFrameCallback presented frame verification.
R4_strictBrowserTimelineVerification.resolution: Created scripts/test_live_browser_f08.cjs driving playback solely via range slider input/change event dispatch (nativeSetter.call(slider, target)). Tested 3 seek points (60s, 200s, 400s), captured RVFC presentation callbacks (presentedFrames, 1920x1080), asserted target-near settling (|t1 - target| <= 5s), verified post-seek continued advancement (t2 > t1 + 0.5s), and verified pause stability (drift=0.000s).

R5_reproducibilityAndSnapshotEvidence.finding: Patch reconstruction omitted runbooks changed since base fe55916; Qwen browser discovery/recommendation remained unproven.
R5_reproducibilityAndSnapshotEvidence.resolution: Declared exact base c2d29c04edd58c4cc0a6e648d316285a9377384f. Executed live Qwen3-4B + Phase 23 LoRA on RTX 3050 CUDA (saving qwen_inference_f08.json with Spirited Away, Spider-Verse, Isle of Dogs). Mounted real Google Drive X: (videoplayback.mp4, 29,209,556 B). Optimized WinFsp access with toFile().canRead() to avoid Windows ACL deadlocks. Verified clean shutdown of all 4 services and unmount at handoff.
